say:1:1130612001:1.text: I obtained my wares from Smokey the alchemist after traversing deep valleys, scaling perilous mountains, and facing dangers that would make you cower in fear.
say:1:1130612001:1.source_cn: 这可是我穿越深谷，翻过高山，经历了数不尽的危险和历练后...
say:1:1130612001:1.male: I obtained my wares from Smokey the alchemist after traversing deep valleys, scaling perilous mountains, and facing dangers that would make you cower in fear.
say:1:1130612001:1.female: I obtained my wares from Smokey the alchemist after traversing deep valleys, scaling perilous mountains, and facing dangers that would make you cower in fear.

say:2:1130612002:1.text: He lives in seclusion deep in the Ashen Wastes, only allowing a select few access to his world-class potions!
say:2:1130612002:1.source_cn: 他远在荒角沙漠，正在避世隐居！世上只有极少数人才能得到...
say:2:1130612002:1.male: He lives in seclusion deep in the Ashen Wastes, only allowing a select few access to his world-class potions!
say:2:1130612002:1.female: He lives in seclusion deep in the Ashen Wastes, only allowing a select few access to his world-class potions!

say:3:1130612003:1.text: Supplies are limited, so get them while you can!
say:3:1130612003:1.source_cn: 数量有限，欲购从速，手慢无！
say:3:1130612003:1.male: Supplies are limited, so get them while you can!
say:3:1130612003:1.female: Supplies are limited, so get them while you can!
